g.text: Historical TLS claim: timing evidence and an effective-grid mismatch
July 2026 archive, reported A5000. Ratios: 30–171×. Exact implementation SHAs are missing.
“Affected” refers to the narrow-duration edge, not every duration or an observed missed-transit rate. No extrapolated timings are plotted.
